This '''individual''' was an [[Oblee]] who resided on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Oblis]] in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and was one of the world's [[scientist-philosopher]]s, the Oblees' leading caste. After a [[shadow creature]] traveled to Oblis and melded itself into the planet's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], the scientist-philosophers determined to use the [[Darkstaff]], an ancient [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]] brought to the world by a [[Unidentified wandering trader|wandering trader]], to power a machine that would allow them to send the shadow creature away from Oblis. This individual was tasked with operating the machine and inserted the Darkstaff into a tray used to power the mechanism. However, the machine did not drive the shadow creature away and instead triggered a [[Destruction of Oblis|large cataclysm]] that resulted in the destruction of Oblis.

Later during the Clone Wars, the [[Heroes of Cularin]] had a vision of the last moments of Oblis as the scientist-philosopher inserted the Darkstaff into the machine designed to drive the shadow creature away from Oblis.
